note: Planner colours shared by every widget of the G-RRT* page (CONTRACT.md, Round 4). The nine OMPL planners take the colours of the paper's convergence plots, sampled from its PDFs, except G-RRT*, whose green #64a11b is darkened to #4f9216 so that it stays apart from AORRTC's amber under protanopia. FCIT* is not in the paper (VAMP only) and takes a magenta apart from every paper colour. Informed RRT* (search widget) takes the paper's RRT* colour. Some paper pairs are close (RRT*-Connect and AIT*, AORRTC and EIT*); legends, toggles, tooltips and tables carry the identity as well. Amber and the light colours never colour text: text stays in ink with a coloured mark beside it, and small green text uses --gr-green-text.
